==About me==
I'm a fan of all things fantasy and science-fiction. I find historical fictions and other fictions with strong historical context and allusions fascinating. Mythologies and legends as well. Of course, I also love fantasies and science-fiction that are their own worlds entirely.[[File:Rees_family_crest.jpg|thumb|The Rees Family Crest]]


The Wheel of Time is an all time favorite with its references to the legends of Arthur Pendragon and Merlin. It is an amazingly intricate and yet simple story, without a doubt one of the best of all time.
